advancements.jsindustrial.foundation.roo: Get your hands on your first machine
jsindustrial.cable.research_link.job: Joins research computers into a group, one group for each run; a dyed run is a group of its own.
jsindustrial.circuit.integrated.what: The first made by lithography, with the ultraviolet light of mercury lamps.
jsindustrial.circuit.mechanical.what: Logic of cams and gears, with no electricity.
jsindustrial.circuit.nanoscale.what: Deep ultraviolet lithography, then extreme ultraviolet.
jsindustrial.circuit.omniversal.made: In the Creation Forge, with no Clean Room.
jsindustrial.circuit.quantum.made: In the Clean Room, beside a microgravity chamber.
jsindustrial.circuit.quantum.what: Quantum states laid layer by layer.
jsindustrial.circuit.singularity.made: In the Clean Room, beside an antimatter chamber.
jsindustrial.circuit.transcendent.made: In the Clean Room, beside an open Wormhole Gate.
jsindustrial.circuit.transistor.what: Discrete silicon transistors, grown in the Czochralski furnace, on a printed board.
jsindustrial.circuit.vacuum_tube.made: By hand, with the soldering iron.
jsindustrial.circuit.vacuum_tube.what: Thermionic valves on a printed board: a tungsten filament, glass and a Kovar seal.

jsindustrial.crc.screen.tip.research: The research it made its last second, in points a second
jsindustrial.crc.screen.tip.research_now: Researches it now, for the whole group
jsindustrial.crc.screen.tip.shed: The heat its cooling took away its last second; red while it sheds less than it makes
jsindustrial.crc.screen.waiting_for_need: Waiting: its team does not know what it needs
jsindustrial.data.crystal.from: From the X-ray Diffractometer, the Electron Microscope and a synchrotron's light: the structure of a solid.
jsindustrial.data.particle.from: From a Particle Detector set against an accelerator, at each of its runs.
jsindustrial.data.sample.from: From the Mass Spectrometer and the ICP Mass Spectrometer: what a material is made of, and its isotopes.
jsindustrial.data.spectral.from: From the Optical Spectrometer and the NMR Spectrometer: the lines of light of each element.
jsindustrial.drawing.instrument: Instrument: PI is a pressure gauge
jsindustrial.guide.chapter.about: Machines that turn ores and metals into the parts everything else is made from, and the energy they run on.
jsindustrial.guide.coal_generator.balloo: The front: open it to put fuel in.
Energy goes out on every side.
jsindustrial.guide.coal_generator.defini: Forge Energy, the energy most machine mods count in. A generator makes it, a cable carries it, a machine spends it.
The game's beat: 20 ticks make a second.
jsindustrial.guide.coal_generator.fix1: No machine or cable touches it, or its Sides tab closes that face. Put a machine against a face, or lay Insulated Copper Cable.
jsindustrial.guide.coal_generator.fix2: Nothing takes its energy. While it is full it stops burning, and goes on when there is room.
jsindustrial.guide.coal_generator.fix3: One generator makes 20 FE a tick; a Macerator spends 40. Put a second generator against it.
jsindustrial.guide.coal_generator.for: Powering the other machines, at the start, before anything better exists.
jsindustrial.guide.coal_generator.proble: It works but nothing gets energy.
It stopped and its energy is full.
jsindustrial.guide.coal_generator.title: Coal Generator
jsindustrial.guide.coal_generator.use1: Place the generator, and a machine against it.
jsindustrial.guide.coal_generator.use2: Put fuel in its slot: coal, charcoal, planks, logs.
jsindustrial.guide.coal_generator.use3: One coal burns 1,600 ticks and makes 32,000 FE.
jsindustrial.guide.coal_generator.use4: It holds 16,000 FE and gives up to 1,000 FE twice a second.
jsindustrial.guide.coal_generator.what: A block that burns fuel to make energy: 20 FE a tick while the fuel burns.
jsindustrial.guide.compressor.balloon1: The front: the side you open it from.
jsindustrial.guide.compressor.balloon2: Power and items go in on any side.
jsindustrial.guide.compressor.fix1: No power: the generator needs coal and must touch the Compressor.
jsindustrial.guide.compressor.fix2: One generator makes 20 FE (units of power) a tick (a twentieth of a second); the Compressor needs 30. Add a second generator.
jsindustrial.guide.compressor.fix3: The right box is full. Take the plates out.
jsindustrial.guide.compressor.fix4: Only iron and copper ingots become plates.
jsindustrial.guide.compressor.for: Making iron and copper plates from ingots.
jsindustrial.guide.compressor.title: Compressor
jsindustrial.guide.compressor.use2: Place a Coal Generator so it touches the Compressor, on any side.
jsindustrial.guide.compressor.use3: Put coal in the generator: it makes power while the coal burns.
jsindustrial.guide.compressor.use4: Open the Compressor and put ingots in the left box.
jsindustrial.guide.compressor.use5: Every 6 seconds one plate appears in the right box. Take them out.
jsindustrial.guide.compressor.what: A machine that presses a metal ingot flat into a plate.
jsindustrial.guide.computational_researc: A block is wrong, or the entries are not as it takes them: one Power Entry, at most one of each other, the Inlet with its Outlet. Jade on the Terminal says what is wrong.
No discovery is chosen, its data is short, your team lacks what it comes after, or no power reaches the Power Entry.
It burnt: past 100 °C the hungriest one burns. Add coolers; SHED turns red while it sheds less heat than it makes.
Making discoveries, which open the recipes that need them. A discovery costs research points, which its processors compute, and the data it asks for.
Research Processor: 1 point a second for 5 kW. Integrated Research Processor: 4 points for 20 kW. Nanoscale Research Processor: 16 points for 80 kW. All the power a processor draws becomes heat.
Heat Sink: sheds 5 kW to the air. Liquid Cooler: up to 15 kW into the water flowing from the Coolant Inlet to the Outlet. Heat Pipe Cooler: up to 25 kW out through the Heat Port.
Build it of CRC Casing, the CRC Terminal in the middle of the front's bottom row.
Along the middle of its middle layer, from the front: Bus, Gate, Bus, Gate, Bus, Gate, Bus.
In the six places of the rear's two lower rows: one CRC Power Entry, and if you want them a Link Socket, a Coolant Inlet with its Outlet and a Heat Port; casing in the rest.
Bring 11 kV to the Power Entry.
Open the Terminal: fill its 27 places, put data in its data places, and pick a discovery on its Research tab.
A research computer of 1959: three grey cabinets 9 blocks deep, 3 wide and 3 high, built of its own blocks. It works your team's discoveries.
jsindustrial.guide.dust_ingots_plates.fi: Dust is smelted, not pressed. Smelt it into an ingot first.
jsindustrial.guide.dust_ingots_plates.fo: They are the parts later machines and recipes are made from. They belong to J's Core, so every mod of the series uses the same ones.
jsindustrial.guide.dust_ingots_plates.ge: Make them with the machines or the hand tools, or take them from the J's Tech tab.
jsindustrial.guide.dust_ingots_plates.he: What smelts into an iron ingot
jsindustrial.guide.dust_ingots_plates.pr: Dust will not go into the Compressor.
jsindustrial.guide.dust_ingots_plates.us: Grind an ore in the Macerator: two dusts.
Smelt each dust in a furnace or the Electric Furnace: an ingot.
Press the ingots in the Compressor: plates.
Smelt a scrap: a nugget, half the metal it holds.
jsindustrial.guide.dust_ingots_plates.wh: What the machines make of iron, copper, gold, tin and bronze: dust ground from ores and ingots, plates pressed from ingots, wire, nuggets, blocks, and the scraps drawing leaves.
jsindustrial.guide.electric_furnace.ball: The front: the side you open it from.
Power and items go in on any side.
jsindustrial.guide.electric_furnace.fix1: It spends 30 FE a tick and one generator makes 20. Add a second generator.
jsindustrial.guide.electric_furnace.fix2: A furnace does not smelt it either.
jsindustrial.guide.electric_furnace.for: Smelting anything a furnace smelts, by the same recipes, in 8 seconds an item, a little faster than a furnace, for 30 FE a tick.
jsindustrial.guide.electric_furnace.use1: Place the Electric Furnace, with a Coal Generator touching it.
jsindustrial.guide.electric_furnace.use3: Put what to smelt in the furnace's left box; take the result from the right one.
jsindustrial.guide.electric_furnace.what: A furnace that runs on energy instead of fuel.
jsindustrial.guide.geological_sections.f: The rocks, in their hatching and their colours
Section A-A, in the rocks' colours
That line is a fault: the vein goes on, higher or lower, on its other side.
Knowing where a vein runs before digging for it.
jsindustrial.guide.geological_sections.g: These drawings are in The World, where the ores and their veins are.
jsindustrial.guide.geological_sections.p: A vein stops at a line.
jsindustrial.guide.geological_sections.u: Each rock is drawn in its hatching; the legend names it.
Where a fault crosses the layers, the same layer stands higher on one side than the other, and so does the vein.
Click COLOURS over the section to see each rock as its block.
jsindustrial.guide.geological_sections.w: The ground as if cut through with a knife: its layers of rock from the surface down, the veins of ore in them, the faults where the ground broke and slid, and the boreholes that prove it.
jsindustrial.guide.hand_tools.fix1: It wore out: the hammer and the plate last 128 uses, the mortar 64. Make another.
jsindustrial.guide.hand_tools.for: Starting without waiting on a machine. By hand always gives less than a machine does.
jsindustrial.guide.hand_tools.get: Make them at a crafting table, from iron, sticks, flint and stone.
jsindustrial.guide.hand_tools.title: Hand tools
jsindustrial.guide.hand_tools.use1: Put the tool and the ingots in a crafting table.
jsindustrial.guide.hand_tools.use2: Forge Hammer: three ingots make two plates.
jsindustrial.guide.hand_tools.use3: Draw Plate: an ingot makes a wire; every eighth wire leaves a scrap of the metal.
jsindustrial.guide.hand_tools.use4: Mortar: three ingots make two dusts.
jsindustrial.guide.hand_tools.use5: The tool stays in the grid, a use worn each time.
jsindustrial.guide.hand_tools.what: Three tools for the first plates, wire and dust, before any machine: the Forge Hammer, the Draw Plate and the Mortar.
jsindustrial.guide.hot_water.fix1: Its Coolant Outlet is full, or its Inlet is dry. Pipe the hot water away and bring cold water in.
jsindustrial.guide.hot_water.for: Carrying a machine's heat away: cold water goes in, takes the heat and leaves hot.
jsindustrial.guide.hot_water.get: From a CRC's Coolant Outlet while its Liquid Coolers work, or from the creative menu, J's Industrial tab.
jsindustrial.guide.hot_water.problem1: The CRC heats though its Liquid Coolers are in place.
jsindustrial.guide.hot_water.title: Hot water
jsindustrial.guide.hot_water.use1: Pipe it away from the Coolant Outlet, into a Tank or wherever it is wanted.
jsindustrial.guide.hot_water.use2: Keep cold water coming into the Coolant Inlet.
jsindustrial.guide.hot_water.what: Water warmed to 60 °C: what a cooling loop gives back, such as the Liquid Coolers of a Computational Research Centre.
jsindustrial.guide.macerator.balloon1: The front: the side you open it from.
jsindustrial.guide.macerator.balloon2: Power and items go in on any side.
jsindustrial.guide.macerator.fix1: It spends 40 FE a tick and one generator makes 20. Add a second generator.
jsindustrial.guide.macerator.fix2: Its boxes on the right are full. Take the dust out.
jsindustrial.guide.macerator.fix3: It grinds ores, raw ores and the ingots of metals; nothing else.
jsindustrial.guide.macerator.for: Getting more from each ore: one ore or raw ore becomes two dusts, and each dust smelts into an ingot. A mineral gives a little of what it holds besides.
jsindustrial.guide.macerator.note1: Every ore, raw mineral and ingot is ground the same way; JEI or EMI lists them all, with the byproducts each gives. Each dust of a metal smelts into its ingot.
jsindustrial.guide.macerator.title: Macerator
jsindustrial.guide.macerator.use1: Place the Macerator, with a Coal Generator touching it.
jsindustrial.guide.macerator.use3: Put an ore, a raw ore or an ingot in the Macerator's left box.
jsindustrial.guide.macerator.use4: Every 10 seconds two dusts appear on the right, and now and then a byproduct: chalcopyrite gives sulfur, and a little gold and silver.
jsindustrial.guide.macerator.what: A machine that grinds ores and metals into dust.
jsindustrial.guide.making_and_moving_pow: The energy a machine can store, like a small battery inside it. It keeps a machine working for a while after its power stops.
The cable does not reach it, or the generator has no fuel.
Together they spend more than the generators make, or more than the cable carries. Add a generator, or a second cable.
Running machines that cannot stand against a generator, and running many from a few generators.
A machine on the cable gets nothing.
Coal Generator: makes 20 FE a tick. Macerator: 40. Compressor: 30. Electric Furnace: 30.

The Insulated Copper Cable is the series' basic cable, J's Core's: it carries up to 500 FE a tick and loses a tenth over a hundred blocks. It is laid in the shared cable block of the series, in a lane of its own, so it runs beside the cables of other mods without joining them.
Power: making it and moving it
Place the generator and the machines.
Lay Insulated Copper Cable from the generator to each machine, like a line of blocks.
Add generators until the machines stop working in bursts.
How energy goes from a generator to the machines: through the faces that touch, or along Insulated Copper Cable.
jsindustrial.guide.manual.plant_drawings: New to machines? Start with JI-GN-001, then JI-GS-001.
jsindustrial.guide.pids.figure3: The same pipes, as their blocks; the valve and the pump are to come
jsindustrial.guide.pids.fix1: It comes with its part of the mod; until then the 3D view shows a plain block in its place.
jsindustrial.guide.pids.for: Seeing where a fluid goes, what moves it, what can stop it and what measures it.
jsindustrial.guide.pids.get: These drawings are in Fluids and Gases and in Chemistry.
jsindustrial.guide.pids.problem1: A block of the drawing is not in the game yet.
jsindustrial.guide.pids.title: Reading P&IDs
jsindustrial.guide.pids.use1: Read it along the arrows, from the vessel on.
jsindustrial.guide.pids.use2: A bubble is an instrument: its letters say what it measures, PI a pressure, and its number which one it is.
jsindustrial.guide.pids.use3: Click 3D over the example to see the same pipes as their blocks.
jsindustrial.guide.pids.what: A piping and instrumentation diagram, the drawing of a chemical plant: the vessels, the pumps and valves on the pipes between them, and the instruments that read them.
jsindustrial.guide.reading_drawings.fix1: It goes on, on its next sheet: the title block says which sheet of how many.
jsindustrial.guide.reading_drawings.for: Reading every other drawing of this set.
jsindustrial.guide.reading_drawings.get: You have it: these drawings come in the Plant Drawings folder, from the creative menu, J's Industrial tab.
jsindustrial.guide.reading_drawings.head: The model
The balloons
The title block
The drawing number
The switch
The zones
jsindustrial.guide.reading_drawings.prob: A drawing seems to stop halfway.
jsindustrial.guide.reading_drawings.text: Each machine is shown as its block. Drag it to turn it, and turn the mouse wheel to bring it closer. A multiblock has buttons that add or take away a layer.
A number in a circle points at a part; the legend under the model says what it is.
The box in the corner names the set and the drawing, its number, which sheet of how many, and its revision.
JI, the letters of the drawing's section, and its place there: JI-GS-002 is the second drawing of Getting Started.
A drawing that can be shown two ways has a switch over it, DIAGRAM and 3D or LINES and COLOURS. Click a word to see it that way.
The numbers along the top and the letters down the side cut the sheet into zones, so a place on it can be named: B4.
jsindustrial.guide.reading_drawings.use1: Start at the drawing list: its drawings stand under the titles of their sections.
jsindustrial.guide.reading_drawings.use2: Click a drawing's number or its title to open it.
jsindustrial.guide.reading_drawings.use3: Turn the sheets with the arrows, the arrow keys or the mouse wheel.
jsindustrial.guide.reading_drawings.what: A drawing shows one thing of the plant on one sheet or more, the way engineers draw a plant: a machine as its block, which you turn, with numbers that point at what matters, and the plant's systems in the diagrams of their trades.
jsindustrial.guide.research_data.fix1: Its data ran short. The card on its Research tab says how many more, and what gives them.
jsindustrial.guide.research_data.for: Discoveries ask for them. A discovery that asks for 10 data spends one each tenth of the way.
jsindustrial.guide.research_data.problem: It stopped part of the way.
jsindustrial.guide.research_data.title: Research data
jsindustrial.guide.research_data.use1: Put them in the data places of a Computational Research Centre, each kind in its own.
jsindustrial.guide.research_data.use2: The CRCs of your team in one group spend the data of all of them.
jsindustrial.guide.research_data.what: The records the instruments leave: Sample Data, what a material is made of; Crystal Data, the structure of a solid; Spectral Data, the lines of light of each element; Particle Data, what an accelerator's runs show.
jsindustrial.guide.research_groups.fix1: It has no Link Socket, the cable does not reach it, or its run is another colour. Its Group tab shows the CRCs it is joined to.
jsindustrial.guide.research_groups.fix2: Nothing is lost: the progress is your team's. Join them again and they go on.
jsindustrial.guide.research_groups.for: Researching faster. Each team counts its own CRCs: the strongest whole, each other at nine tenths.
jsindustrial.guide.research_groups.probl: A CRC is not in the group.
jsindustrial.guide.research_groups.title: Research groups
jsindustrial.guide.research_groups.use1: Give each CRC a CRC Link Socket on its rear.
jsindustrial.guide.research_groups.use2: Lay the cable from socket to socket.
jsindustrial.guide.research_groups.use3: Choose the discovery on any of them: the whole group works it, then its queue.
jsindustrial.guide.research_groups.use4: Dye a run to keep two groups apart: runs of two colours never join.
jsindustrial.guide.research_groups.what: The Research Link Cable joins Computational Research Centres into a group: every CRC on one run of it works the same discovery.
The symbols of a single-line diagram
The same plant, as its blocks
It goes on to a symbol on another drawing, which its tag names.
Seeing how energy goes from the generators to the machines, and where it can be cut.
These drawings are in Power, and wherever the plant moves energy.
A line seems to end in the air.
Follow the line from a generator down to each machine.
A breaker is where the circuit can be opened: what comes after it stops.
Click 3D over the example to see the same plant as its blocks.
The drawing of an electric grid: one line stands for every wire of a circuit, and each part on it is a symbol.
jsindustrial.guide.tank.fix1: It already holds another fluid, or it is full.
jsindustrial.guide.tank.for: Keeping a fluid, and handing it to pipes, cables and whatever takes fluids from a block.
jsindustrial.guide.tank.problem1: The fluid does not go in.
jsindustrial.guide.tank.title: Tank
jsindustrial.guide.tank.use1: Fill it with a bucket or a pipe, and empty it the same way.
jsindustrial.guide.tank.use2: Break it and its item keeps the fluid: place it again and the fluid is back.
jsindustrial.guide.tank.what: A plain tank that holds up to 16 buckets of one fluid.
jsindustrial.knowledge.element_beyond: An element beyond the known table
jsindustrial.manual.from_the_js_tech_tab: Creative menu, J's Tech tab: it is the series' own. No crafting recipe yet.
jsindustrial.manual.from_the_tab: Creative menu, J's Industrial tab. No crafting recipe yet.
